raw_html: [[Soul of the Elements]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]While you are centered, this item grants you a bonus depending on your current monk stance. ** Beyond the Soul of Storm[[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]On hit: 3 to 18 electric damage, and target [[bleed]]s for 1 to 8 bleed damage periodically. ** Beyond the Soul of Stone[[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]+10 Insight bonus to [[AC]] and [[reflex]] Saves. ** Beyond the Soul of Flame[[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]Chance on hit: [[blind]] and [[fear]]. ** Beyond the Soul of Tide[[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]Chance on hit: [[trip]].
